name: com.yuankunhuang.reflow
description: High performance uGUI layout: measure/arrange protocol, frame-coalesced refresh that always applies in the same frame, virtualized pooled lists, grids, expandable grids, selection and spawn/reflow animations.

samples.description: Vertical/Horizontal/Grid layouts, size fitters and follow chains built from code.
10,000 pooled items in a ScrollRect with spawn animation and scroll-to.
Grid that opens a detail row under the clicked cell.
Side by side timing against uGUI LayoutGroup + ContentSizeFitter.
